message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have real‑time internet access, so I can’t pull up today’s exact forecast for Boston. For the most accurate and up‑to‑date information you might want to:

1. Check your phone’s built‑in Weather app (or Google/Apple Maps “Weather” feature).  
2. Visit a reputable meteorological site such as [weather.com](https://www.weather.com), the National Weather Service ([nws.noaa.gov](http://www.nws.noaa.gov)), or AccuWeather.  
3. Use voice assistants like Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant—just say something like “What’s the weather in Boston?”

If you let me know what kind of details you're looking for (e.g., temperature range, chance of rain, wind speed) I can explain how those factors typically play out during this season in Boston!
